$description: boopis design tokens. Generated by design-system/build-tokens.mjs from tokens.css; do not edit by hand. Values follow the W3C Design Tokens format (2025.10). Theme presets are modes: every themed token carries its catalog value in $value and every preset in $extensions.boopis.modes. Corners and density are two further modifiers on radius and control tokens.

graphite.name: Graphite
graphite.note: Neutral grey, close to the Figma

case.apply: data-hx-case on <html>; --ui-case is none or lowercase, applied to interface labels only

ground.apply: data-ground="dock" on the dock root or a card inside it: re-derives the text, line and fill roles from #000

2xs.$description: Mono meta: times, costs, call numbers, kbd, stamps.

xs.$description: Labels, group headings, tooltips, secondary lines, chips.

s.$description: Interface default: rows, buttons, menus, tabs.

m.$description: Reading: conversation prose, the composer, card titles.

l.$description: View and dialog titles, a bot name in its header.

xl.$description: The one display size: a bot name being made.

s.$description: Buttons, rows, fields, wells, the segmented track, tooltips.

m.$description: Cards, the composer, menus, popovers, notices, request cards.

l.$description: Sheets, dialogs, the palette, the dock, where the ground meets the frame.

floor.$description: The smallest inner radius of a nested corner: inner = max(floor, outer − gap); under it the padding gives way.

pill.$description: Chips (a capsule), dots, the switch, anything inside a pill.

row.$description: One-line row: list rows, menu items, options.

control-s.$description: Icon buttons, small buttons, the send button.

right-rail-w.$description: Right panel closed: the strip that holds the context measure.

measure.$description: Prose width (col-w minus margin-w), about 80 characters.

composer-gap.$description: Between the composer and the dock (or the window edge).

right-w.$description: Open right panel and the bot settings sheet: clamp(300px, 18vw, 340px).

local.$description: The highest literal z-index allowed inside a component, and only under isolation: isolate (R-elev-5). Modal dialogs use the top layer (showModal), above every value here.

3.$description: Layout travel, sheets, card height changes.

indicator.$description: A segmented thumb or page indicator travelling.

breathe.$description: The one loop: a running dot breathes (opacity .35 to 1, alternate). Stopped under reduced motion.

hold.$description: Hold to approve. One value everywhere (owner decision; the dock used 650, bots 1100).

ease.$description: Every UI step: hover, colour, fade, menu.

settle.$description: Layout travel and anything settling into place. Named --spring in CSS; it never overshoots.

travel.$description: In-out, only for the breathing dot and symmetric travel.

meta.$description: Mono meta in the call-number margin.

mono.$description: Not a DTCG unit; read it as -0.01em.

smoothing.$description: Figma corner smoothing of every corner (0.6, as iOS); drawn as a path by HX.ui.squircle in every engine.

boopis.algorithm: figma-squircle (MIT, Tien Pham), after Daniel Furse, Desperately seeking squircles
boopis.nesting: A container declares --r-outer and --pad; what sits in its corners takes --r-in = max(--r-floor, --r-outer − --pad).

2xs.$description: Chevrons of disclosures and group heads.

xs.$description: Section chevrons, glyphs in mono chips, schedule marks.

s.$description: The command field, file chips, task and inline marks, model marks in running text.

l.$description: Buttons, rows, the send button, origin slots, the palette.

gap.$description: Icon to label: buttons, menu items, rows.

gap-tight.$description: Icon to label in capsules and controls of 26px and under.

dialog.$description: Dialogs and sheets: the close button and the head's tabs.

dock.$description: A card or row at the top of the dock slab.

card.$description: A well, a footer button, a stamp in a card.

composer.$description: Attach, chips, mic and send in the composer.

field.$description: Key chips in a tooltip or at a field's end.

gap.$description: A menu, popover or tooltip from its anchor.

margin.$description: The least distance from a floating surface to the window edge.

offset.$description: Outside the element; -2px (inside) in tracks and floating surfaces.

disabled.$description: Proposed (R-state-6): a disabled control drawn in fills (send, switch, field).

size.$description: The bar's box, both axes; the track is transparent.

thumb.$description: The thumb at rest, a capsule centred in the bar.

thumb-active.$description: The thumb while hovered or dragged.

inset.$description: Drawer: fields, approval and ship cards, the command field, wells. Set into whatever it sits on.

frame.$description: Cabinet: title bar, sidebars, the open right panel, menus, palette, dialogs.

ground.$description: Reading room: the ground the work sits on.

raised.$description: Card stock: what the user wrote or is writing (request cards, the composer), tooltips, notices.

pressed.$description: Pressed fills, the kbd inside a tooltip, scrollbar thumbs.

dock.$description: The dock slab. Pitch black in every theme; not themeable, never offered in the customizer.

default.$description: Body text and labels. Lines and hover fills are derived from it.

strong.$description: Titles, the current row, a hovered icon.

quiet.$description: Meta that must stay readable: times, costs, call numbers, group headings.

faint.$description: Decoration and disabled only. Never carries meaning on its own.

default.$description: Icons in icon buttons and rows.

fill.$description: Bone: the selected segment, primary buttons, the send button, a checked switch.

default.$description: You are here: focus ring, current marker, active rung, checked items, caret.

soft.$description: Text selection; the flash on a panel section opened from elsewhere.

fill.$description: You owe something: dots, stamp outlines, the blank underline.

text.$description: Attention as text: "waiting for you", "needs you", "failed".

warn.$description: A contrast warning in the customizer. Never attention.

strong.$description: Hovered outlines, empty radio rings, the switch track.

field.$description: Text-field outline: 3:1 against the field and the frame.

boopis.formula: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 42%, transparent); 54% when data-hx-theme="light"

hover.$description: Hover fill on rows, icon buttons, chips.

current.$description: The selected row, the active dialog tab, a focused menu item.

off.$description: An inactive non-text mark: a page dot, a ladder station still to come. 3:1 on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11) and well under the active marks (--text-dim, --brass). Library token (components.css); promote to tokens.css.

boopis.formula: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-quiet) 55%, var(--text-faint)); --text-faint (ink 42%) on the dock ground

scrim.$description: Behind the palette, dialogs and overlay drawers.

pop.$description: Things that float over other things: menus, palette, dialogs, popovers, notices.

side.$description: A left drawer over the ground (overlay mode).

side-r.$description: The right panel in overlay mode.

mono.$description: Code, paths, numbers, times, costs, model names, call numbers, kbd.

display.$description: One per screen at most: the name of a bot being made.

title.$description: View and dialog titles, a bot name in its header.

reading.$description: Conversation prose, request cards, the composer. Measure 608px.

code.$description: Inline code chips (12px; the 12.5px variants are drift).

meta.$description: Call numbers, times, costs, state words, kbd.

icon-axis.$description: Every glyph and orb in the sidebar centres on x = 28.

text-line.$description: Every label in the sidebar starts at x = 44.

inset.$description: The actions group and the bar sit this far from the box edge (--composer-pad).

action-radius.$description: Mic, send, attach and chips: max(--r-floor, --r-m − inset).

color-active.$description: Hovered or dragged: 3:1 like every non-text mark (proposed, R-scroll-3).

1.$description: In flow: raised and inset surfaces. Tone and a hairline, never a shadow.

boopis.z: --z-palette; modal dialogs use the top layer
